paper.title_en: Uniqueness of Static Black Holes in Lovelock Gravity
paper.abstract_en: Black hole uniqueness is one of the fundamental predictions of general relativity: the spherically symmetric Schwarzschild--Tangherlini spacetime is the unique regular, asymptotically flat, static vacuum black hole solution of Einstein's equations. We show that an analogous result holds perturbatively in Lovelock gravity. Assuming the appropriate positive-mass rigidity statement, any regular, asymptotically flat, static vacuum black hole solution of Lovelock gravity on a generic branch admitting a regular Taylor expansion about general relativity is uniquely determined, at fixed ADM mass, by the corresponding spherically symmetric Lovelock black hole solution. In particular, Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet gravity admits no distinct nonspherical static branch perturbatively connected to Schwarzschild--Tangherlini, and the unique solution is Boulware--Deser. The same recursive mechanism extends to the full Lovelock class. Our result shows that static black hole uniqueness can extend beyond general relativity and is not a property peculiar to the Einstein equations.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文探讨Lovelock引力下静态黑洞的唯一性，并将其作为广义相对论经典唯一性定理向高阶曲率理论的推广，问题集中、理论深度高；结果以微扰论证并带有明确前提（正质量刚性假设），对研究黑洞唯一性及修改引力基础的研究者具有较高的点击阅读价值。
decision.title_zh: Lovelock引力中静态黑洞的唯一性
decision.abstract_zh: 黑洞唯一性是广义相对论的基本预言之一：球对称的Schwarzschild--Tangherlini时空是Einstein方程唯一正则、渐近平坦、静态真空黑洞解。我们证明，在Lovelock引力中微扰地存在类似结果。假设相应的正质量刚性陈述成立，则Lovelock引力在允许关于广义相对论具有正则Taylor展开的某个一般分支上，任何正则、渐近平坦、静态真空黑洞解，在固定ADM质量下，都由相应的球对称Lovelock黑洞解唯一确定。特别地，Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet引力不存在与Schwarzschild--Tangherlini微扰相连的、不同的非球对称静态分支，且唯一解是Boulware--Deser解。同样的递推机制可推广到整个Lovelock类。我们的结果表明，静态黑洞唯一性可以超越广义相对论，并非Einstein方程所特有的性质。
